title: Chapter 1281 - 31: Infinite Void, Fifth Layer

Chapter 1281 - 31: Infinite Void, Fifth Layer

Chapter 1281: Chapter 31: Infinite Void, Fifth Layer

In the vast Desolate Void.

Lin Yuan drifted along with the thin Chaos Qi.

Except for entities like the Eye of Myriad Laws that had deeper Causal Sensing with Lin Yuan.

Other powerful beings, even if passing nearby, couldn’t perceive Lin Yuan in the slightest.

Lin Yuan’s form and spirit seemed to merge as one with endless Chaos Qi and the vast void.

"That dimension rift?"

Lin Yuan casually glanced in a certain direction; he had already condensed an avatar to proceed.

Regarding dimension rifts, Lin Yuan was still quite cautious.

The Xuanhuang obtained the Thirteenth-level weapon, Sky Void Tripod, from a dimension rift.

Within that dimension rift, even the Xuanhuang almost got seriously injured despite his Invincible Great Saint power, showing the danger of dimension rifts.

Lin Yuan’s current strength certainly far surpassed the Xuanhuang at that time, but he wouldn’t be careless.

Sending only an avatar was both confidence in himself and primarily a probe.

Even if hidden within that dimension rift there was danger unnoticed by the Eye of Myriad Laws.

At most, Lin Yuan would lose an avatar.

A thought would be enough to condense another.

No impact on himself whatsoever.

"I hope everything goes smoothly."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Even if the Eye of Myriad Laws guaranteed, in case Lin Yuan didn’t retrieve that Magic Origin Fruit.

Just taking action would mean the causal ties between the two were settled.

But Lin Yuan naturally hoped for things to go smoothly.

After all, the Eye of Myriad Laws saved him quite a lot of trouble back then.

Without the Eye of Myriad Laws, even with Lin Yuan’s current strength, wanting to spread branches of the Martial Arts Evolution Road.

Would require a tremendous amount of effort and time, and the outcome wouldn’t necessarily match that of the Eye of Myriad Laws.

Even those as powerful as the Invincible Great Saint can only overlook certain eras and ultimately must strive for the Thirteenth-level.

Yet, special existences like the Eye of Myriad Laws are almost eternally enduring; as long as the Chaos Void doesn’t perish, they can exist indefinitely.

...

"Hmm?"

"Is the fourth layer of ’Infinite Void’ almost mastered?"

Lin Yuan’s mind moved slightly, separating an avatar of awareness to descend into his internal universe.

The vast internal universe boundlessly stretched, at this moment on the verge of completing some transformation.

"Stop."

Lin Yuan immediately halted the final transformation of "Infinite Void".

"The ’Infinite Void’ legacy I cultivate was created by a time life of the Chaos Void, using Chaos Void as the ultimate goal; cultivating theoretically to the seventh layer means the internal universe can transform into an existence equivalent to the Chaos Void in scale."

Lin Yuan thought to himself.

Of course, the so-called seventh layer, even the time life who created this legacy did not cultivate up to.

If truly cultivating the seventh layer, it would count as powerful even among the Thirteenth-level.

Even without becoming the Time Lord, it would be close.

In the second Source World, the pursuit of the Master of Wushan is to paint a ’Source World’.

Once accomplished, one can stand among the Time Lords.

While the ’Infinite Void’ legacy aims to nurture a Chaos Void.

Though the processes differ, the ultimate goals pursued by both are similar.

"If I had never descended into the first Source World or the second, I might consider this legacy flawless, as it originated from a great time life, their insight and vision how can be wrong..."

"But..."

Lin Yuan shook his head slightly.

Having experienced two Source Worlds, Lin Yuan realized that even time lives are not necessarily correct.

For example, this ’Infinite Void’ legacy isn’t wrong per se, but is the internal universe nurtured comparable to the Chaos Void really perfect?

Even the Chaos Void itself is imperfect, requiring time lives to establish special places to complement it.

How could the internal universe modeled after the Chaos Void be perfect?

It’s just that.

The time life who founded this legacy only had access to the dimension space of Chaos Void.

Without other more perfect dimension spaces for reference, they failed to realize this.

Even if time lives can travel through dimensional rifts, wanting to explore other dimension spaces? Very difficult.

Firstly, they can’t find them.

Secondly, even if they do find them, they would face intense repulsion from the dimension space itself.

Additionally, they would encounter obstruction from the Thirteenth-level time life born in this dimension space.

Like other dimension time lives wanting to approach the Chaos Void would naturally face obstruction from the Chaos Void’s time lives.

But Lin Yuan is different.

With the help of the Myriad Realms Gate, he can silently integrate into the worlds within each dimension space.

There’s even two Source Worlds more perfect than the Chaos Void.

In the first Source World, Lin Yuan observed the Origin Source operation and the micro Source World nurtured inside the Abyss Dragon’s Heart.

His understanding and insight into that Source World surpassed even the Chaos Void.

In the second Source World, Lin Yuan understood the semi-finished Eternal Painting drawn by the Master of Wushan, which depicts that Source World.

Furthermore, the Lord of Heaven Light’s understanding of the rune ’Omni’.

Lin Yuan also gained profound insights, although not entirely understood about the second Source World’s basic operation and essence, it certainly surpassed any carefree third realm strongman of that world.

"My internal universe, the final transformation must not pursue Chaos Void."

Lin Yuan thought silently, pursuing Chaos Void as the final direction, whether he could become a Time Lord is uncertain.

"Taking the myriad realms and endless dimensional dimensions as the foundation, this is the direction my internal universe will transform towards."

In Lin Yuan’s mind flashed bits and pieces of the first Source World and the second Source World, especially their essential operations, starting to slowly integrate them into his own internal universe.
